messages:
Maria Lopez: deploybot just failed the final publish step for release v2.4.0 — ECR rejected image due to missing kms-annotation on attestation.
Maria Lopez: getting this from deploybot: 
deploybot: publish failed: provenance annotation mismatch: required annotation 'kms-key-id' missing in cosign attestation
Liam Chen: ugh, did the cosign step run in CI?
Sophia Patel: CI logs show cosign signed but our metadata inject step returned 204 and empty body. suspect S3 metadata worker timed out.
Nate (oncall): linking the error: `401: annotate: access denied` from metadata-injector. Could be IAM policy change from yesterday.
Maria Lopez: @Liam can you check the service-account that runs metadata-injector? It might have lost kms:Encrypt for new KMS alias.
Liam Chen: checking now. found that the role's policy was updated by infra rollout: removed kms:Encrypt on the inject bucket key — they rotated keys. pinging infra.
release-bot: Scheduled release window 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC — HOLD due to publish failure.
Sophia Patel: we should not revert the staging pin yet. images in staging are fine; only publish to prod was blocked. recommend delaying prod promote until fix.
qa-ingestion: running quick smoke of canary image from staging to confirm nothing else broke.
Maria Lopez: rollback decision: none yet. Plan A: restore kms:Encrypt on injector role -> re-run publish. Plan B: if infra can't change keys quick, retag with prior cosign-attested image and force-publish as emergency with customer notices.
Nate (oncall): I'm escalating to infra ops slack channel, sending them the cosign attestation bundle and the inject logs.
Liam Chen: infra ops responded: key rotation policy prevented re-adding the old alias. They can create a bridge key and grant injector encrypt for 1 hour.
Sophia Patel: that works. once injector can annotate, publish should succeed. also add a retry in metadata-injector for 5xx/204-empty responses.
Maria Lopez: action items: (1) Nate to approve temporary bridge key (2) Liam to re-run deploybot publish after annotation succeeds (3) Sophia to open a PR for retry/backoff + add metric for empty-annotation counts (4) I will update release notes with delay and cause.
Nate (oncall): approved bridge key, infra made change at 3456789040.
deploybot: publish retried at 3456789052 -> success: image pushed to ECR and provenance attestation accepted.
release-bot: Release v2.4.0 mark: published -> schedule canary rollout at 2026-03-21T19:00Z.
Maria Lopez: will add a short blurb to release notes: "Publish delayed due to KMS key rotation affecting metadata injector; temporary bridge key used; improved retry and metric added."
Liam Chen: filing follow-up ticket for infra to include injector role in key-rotation playbook.
Sophia Patel: QA: canary smoke passed, no runtime regressions.
Maria Lopez: thanks team :thumbsup: closing thread once release notes PR merges.
